These intermediate f32 samples stay inside this compound native calculation, not application storage. Public result admission happens after completion. Checked point/LOD policy produces clipped cell corners; native sampled corner heights enter the two actual u/v barycentric formulas. Only their completed result becomes SupportElevation. No raw height escapes this query.

One centre/four probes produce admitted SupportElevation and finite Displacement<Scene> tangent edges; getters retain those checked types. Existing consumer evidence establishes actual cross-product/normalization endpoints, with distinct original normalization policies.
Existing terrain hit stays checked; the vista hit stays SupportElevation through the shared stitch API. Only the stitch numerical kernel extracts metres.

The production weight goes directly to Vec4::lerp in SampleColors. Other inspected presented_color/presented_height helper receivers are existing fixture/test arithmetic. No retained application height or weight state added here.

verdict: The previously pending native interpolation receiver check is satisfied for these enumerated paths; no additional actionable source gap confirmed in that check. Existing ownership/admission and runtime limits remain.
